from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class LiabilityRecord(BaseModel):
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="Name of the company this report belongs to")
    item_label: str | None = Field(description="The exact line item label found in the document (e.g., '负债合计')")
    amount: float | None = Field(description="Numeric value of the liabilities")
    unit: str | None = Field(description="Unit of the amount (e.g., '元', '百万元')")
    report_period: str | None = Field(description="Reporting period (e.g., '2024 年第一季度')")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    liability_records: list[LiabilityRecord]
